newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-SANITAS, HERMIS, ROKISHKIS, LEAD MKT ACTIVITY.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-SANITAS, HERMIS, ROKISHKIS, LEAD MKT ACTIVITY.

text.p: The Lithuanian stock exchange said on Monday that the shares of Hermis Bank , Rokishkis Cheese and Sanitas were the most traded on the official and A group lists last week.

Hermis Bank turned over 1.477 million litas on the central market and registered a deal worth 20.135 million litas in block trades last week. Around five percent of its stocks were sold, dealers said.
Hermis was followed by Rokishkis Cheese which turned over 1.077 million litas on the central market and registered 2.293 million litas in block trades last week.
Sanitas, a pharmaceutical producer, dominated block trades last week turning over 33.779 million litas. D
ealers said around 50 percent of the company's stocks were sold.
Mazheikiu Nafta was the third most active share on the central market in trade of 533,444 litas last.
Naftos Terminals gained the most in the A group, advancing 23.33 percent to 74 litas followed by Snoras Bank which rose by 19.93 percent to 17.99 litas.
Kalnapilis brewery was up to 9.20 litas, up by 19.33 percent over the week.
Kauno Milk eased the most in the A group and lost 10.71 percent to 2.0 litas.
Lietkabelis and Malsena lost 9.64 and 9.60 percent respectively last week.
